import pandas as pd
from libpysal.weights import W
from esda.moran import Moran

# Load dataset and adjacency file
df = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/moran_global_2023_crime.csv')
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Create spatial weights matrix from adjacency data
w = W.from_dataframe(adj_df)

# Extract crime variable (assuming column name 'CRIME')
y = df['CRIME'].values

# Calculate global Moran's I
moran = Moran(y, w)

# Print results
print('Moran\'s I:', moran.I)
print('p-value:', moran.p_sim)
```

p-value: 0.01
```
